name: Karaimu Street Peninsula
tagline: Wooden heritage houses on the way to the castle
description: The historic heart of Trakai, a narrow peninsula lined with colourful wooden Karaim houses running north toward the footbridges and the Island Castle. This is the most atmospheric, walkable, and photogenic stretch, home to the best kibinai restaurants and lake views on both sides.
bestFor: Heritage lovers, walkers, and first-time visitors
pros: Walk straight to the Island Castle footbridges
The best Karaim food and kibinai in town
Lake views on both sides of the peninsula
cons: Busiest and most tourist-priced part of town

name: Peninsula Castle and Town Center
tagline: Everyday Trakai around the older fortress ruins
description: The main town area near the Peninsula Castle ruins and the church, where local life, shops, the bus and train links, and services cluster. It is a little less storybook than the peninsula but more practical and better value for a longer stay, with the lakes still close by.
bestFor: Longer stays and travellers wanting daily convenience
pros: Closest to shops, transport, and services
Better value than the tourist peninsula
Still walking distance to lakes and castle
cons: Less scenic than the lakeside and peninsula
Still a small-town selection of amenities

name: Lake Galve and Totoriskiu Lakeshore
description: The residential and resort-style lakeshore areas fringing Lake Galve and nearby Totoriskiu, dotted with guesthouses, wooden homes, and boat rentals. It is the calmest, greenest option, ideal for swimming, paddling, and slow mornings by the water, with the castle views that make Trakai famous.
bestFor: Nature lovers, couples, and slow-living stays
pros: Direct lake access for swimming and boating
Classic postcard views of the castle
cons: Quiet and sleepy outside peak summer

name: Vilnius (as a base)
tagline: The bigger city home 30 to 40 minutes away
description: Lithuania's capital, a short train or bus ride east, is where most nomads actually base. Vilnius has full coworking, a lively food and nightlife scene, an international community, and the airport, while keeping Trakai an easy day trip whenever you want lakes, castle, and calm.
bestFor: Nomads wanting community, coworking, and nightlife
pros: Full coworking and a real nomad community
Airport and frequent links to Trakai
cons: Not the lakeside heritage experience itself
